title: WorkerGrid Stage 2a: git sync (fetch + origin-based worktree base + push, PF_AUTO_PUSH, /pf sync)
body: core/vcs.py: fetch() + base_ref() (new worktrees branch off origin/<integration> when a remote exists) + sync() + auto_push_enabled(); worker.run_task optionally pushes the feature branch (PF_AUTO_PUSH, default off); new /pf sync verb; vcs_worktree_check covers it. Fixes the 'unpushed pile-up' + stale cross-system workers.
